APPLICATION 23055-T1

SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT
PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
1901-1925 North Clybourn

The Applicant seeks to rezone 1901-1925 North Clybourn and 1904-1908 North Maud from a M1-
2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District to a B3-3 Community Shopping District. The
property is improved with two four story commercial building. The ground floor space has
historically been occupied with legal, nonconforming retail uses. Due to the lapse of all retail
business licenses, retail-related uses are no longer permitted. The rezoning seeks to bring the
buildings into a conforming zoning district that permits retail-related uses, No changes are
proposed to the existing buildings, which have 102,356 square feet of commercial space, are 54
feet in height, and have 71 parking spaces.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans. Pursuant to Section 17-11-0600, the
Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to eliminate the requirement of screening of
vehicular use areas from Clybourn Avenue under Section 17-11-0202-B. Pursuant to Section 17-
11-0603, the Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to eliminate the parkway tree planting
standard along Clybourn Avenue of Section 17-11-0100. Pursuant to Section 17-11-0604-A, the
Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment waiving the requirements of the Chicago
Landscape Ordinance as shown on the plans.
